author: BuzzFeed
title: Dave Chappelle Slams Republicans For Trans Jokes
text:
“I did resent that the Republican Party ran on transgender jokes.'
is mad that the people who constantly punch down at trans people liked his jokes that punched down at trans people., Chappelle said, “I did resent that the Republican Party ran on transgender jokes. You know, I felt like they were doing a weaponized version of what I was doing.
That’s not what I was doing.”He then described an incident on Capitol Hill, when people came up and asked him for photos — though he"didn’t ask how they vote or what their voting record is."and she said, ‘Can I get a picture?’ And I had already taken 40 pictures. I didn’t want to say no in front of everybody, but I didn’t know the phrase ‘I respectfully decline,'" he said."So I just took the picture. And then she posted the picture before I could even get from there to the show and says something to the effect of, ‘Just two people that know that it’s just two genders.’ Just instantly, like, weaponized or politicized. So I got to the arena, and I lit her ass up for doing that. And she should never do that to a person like me," he continued.
